question: Why do chatbots make up an answer rather than admit they do not know?
answer: Because they are graded like students on a test with no penalty for wrong answers. Most benchmarks score 'I don't know' and a wrong answer both as zero, so guessing never loses, and training chases scores. Asked for one author's thesis title, three popular models each gave a wrong title.
move: Score a blank the same as a wrong answer and everyone guesses.
reference: Kalai, Nachum, Vempala & Zhang, Why Language Models Hallucinate, arXiv:2509.04664, 2025
